subject.title: Feishu plugin WebSocket doesn't receive im.message.receive_v1 events

question: Should this issue remain blocked on maintainer-controlled live Feishu WebSocket proof before any automated fix PR is queued?
rationale: Current source and SDK inspection show the intended dispatcher wiring, but only live Feishu proof can tell whether the missing event is caused by Feishu console/scopes, SDK transport, OpenClaw parsing, proxy/liveness state, or a separate plugin runtime path.

options.title: Require Live Feishu Proof
options.body: Keep the issue open, avoid a speculative fix PR, and ask a maintainer or Feishu plugin owner to capture redacted lifecycle-event and message-event logs from the same app.

options.title: Fold Into A Related Inbound Issue
options.body: Treat this as part of another Feishu inbound cluster only if new logs show the same partial-runtime, proxy, or liveness root cause as the canonical related item.

options.title: Queue Diagnostic Instrumentation
options.body: Allow a narrow diagnostic-only PR if maintainers accept extra logs/probes before live proof, but do not treat it as a confirmed message-delivery fix.

recommendation.title: Require Live Feishu Proof
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open, avoid a speculative fix PR, and ask a maintainer or Feishu plugin owner to capture redacted lifecycle-event and message-event logs from the same app.

likelyOwner.reason: The package metadata identifies this handle as the Feishu/Lark plugin community maintainer, making it the best available owner signal for live Feishu-specific proof.
